[1548](#1548)
[1549](#1549)impl Widget for PulseRing {
[1550](#1550)    fn render(&self, buf: &mut Buffer, area: Rect) {
[1551](#1551)        if is_empty(area) || self.rings == 0 {
[1552](#1552)            return;
[1553](#1553)        }
[1554](#1554)
[1555](#1555)        let cx = area.x + area.width / 2;
[1556](#1556)        let cy = area.y + area.height / 2;
[1557](#1557)        let max_radius = (area.width.min(area.height) / 2) as f64;
[1558](#1558)        if max_radius < 1.0 {
[1559](#1559)            return;
[1560](#1560)        }
[1561](#1561)
[1562](#1562)        let right = area.x.saturating_add(area.width);
[1563](#1563)        let bottom = area.y.saturating_add(area.height);
[1564](#1564)
[1565](#1565)        for y in area.y..bottom {
[1566](#1566)            for x in area.x..right {
[1567](#1567)                let dx = x as f64 - cx as f64;
[1568](#1568)                let dy = y as f64 - cy as f64;
[1569](#1569)                let dist = (dx * dx + dy * dy).sqrt();
[1570](#1570)
[1571](#1571)                for ring in 0..self.rings {
[1572](#1572)                    let ring_phase = (self.tick as f64 * 0.1 + ring as f64 * 3.0) % max_radius;
[1573](#1573)                    let diff = (dist - ring_phase).abs();
[1574](#1574)                    if diff < 1.5 {
[1575](#1575)                        let noise = field_noise(x, y, self.tick + ring as u64);
[1576](#1576)                        let style = if diff < 0.8 {
[1577](#1577)                            Style::default()
[1578](#1578)                                .fg(self.palette.high)
[1579](#1579)                                .add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD)
[1580](#1580)                        } else {
[1581](#1581)                            Style::default().fg(self.palette.lane(noise))
[1582](#1582)                        };
[1583](#1583)                        set_styled_char(buf, x, y, '○', style);
[1584](#1584)                        break;
[1585](#1585)                    }
[1586](#1586)                }
[1587](#1587)            }
[1588](#1588)        }
[1589](#1589)    }
[1590](#1590)}

[1596](#1596)    sweep_speed: u64,
[1597](#1597)    palette: AislingPalette,

[1599](#1599)
[1600](#1600)impl Radar {
[1601](#1601)    #[must_use]
[1603](#1603)    pub fn new(sweep_speed: u64) -> Self {
[1604](#1604)        Self {
[1605](#1605)            tick: 0,
[1606](#1606)            sweep_speed: sweep_speed.max(1),
[1607](#1607)            palette: AislingPalette::phosphor(),
[1608](#1608)        }

[1622](#1622)        self

[1624](#1624)}
[1625](#1625)
[1626](#1626)impl Widget for Radar {
[1627](#1627)    fn render(&self, buf: &mut Buffer, area: Rect) {
[1628](#1628)        if is_empty(area) {
[1629](#1629)            return;
[1630](#1630)        }
[1631](#1631)
[1632](#1632)        let cx = area.x + area.width / 2;
[1633](#1633)        let cy = area.y + area.height / 2;
[1634](#1634)        let max_r = (area.width.min(area.height) / 2) as f64;
[1635](#1635)        if max_r < 1.0 {
[1636](#1636)            return;
[1637](#1637)        }
[1638](#1638)
[1639](#1639)        let sweep_angle = (self.tick as f64 / self.sweep_speed as f64) % (std::f64::consts::TAU);
[1640](#1640)        let trail_len = std::f64::consts::PI * 0.6;
[1641](#1641)
[1642](#1642)        let right = area.x.saturating_add(area.width);
[1643](#1643)        let bottom = area.y.saturating_add(area.height);
[1644](#1644)
[1645](#1645)        for y in area.y..bottom {
[1646](#1646)            for x in area.x..right {
[1647](#1647)                let dx = x as f64 - cx as f64;
[1648](#1648)                let dy = y as f64 - cy as f64;
[1649](#1649)                let dist = (dx * dx + dy * dy).sqrt();
[1650](#1650)
[1651](#1651)                if dist > max_r {
[1652](#1652)                    continue;
[1653](#1653)                }
[1654](#1654)
[1655](#1655)                let angle = dy.atan2(dx);
[1656](#1656)                let norm_angle = if angle < 0.0 {
[1657](#1657)                    angle + std::f64::consts::TAU
[1658](#1658)                } else {
[1659](#1659)                    angle
[1660](#1660)                };
[1661](#1661)
[1662](#1662)                let ring = dist as u16;
[1663](#1663)                if ring > 0 && dist % (max_r / 3.0) < 0.5 {
[1664](#1664)                    set_styled_char(buf, x, y, '·', Style::default().fg(self.palette.shadow));
[1665](#1665)                    continue;
[1666](#1666)                }
[1667](#1667)
[1668](#1668)                let diff = (norm_angle - sweep_angle).abs();
[1669](#1669)                let diff = if diff > std::f64::consts::PI {
[1670](#1670)                    std::f64::consts::TAU - diff
[1671](#1671)                } else {
[1672](#1672)                    diff
[1673](#1673)                };
[1674](#1674)
[1675](#1675)                if diff < trail_len {
[1676](#1676)                    let fade = 1.0 - diff / trail_len;
[1677](#1677)                    let noise = field_noise(x, y, self.tick);
[1678](#1678)                    let color = if fade > 0.6 {
[1679](#1679)                        self.palette.high
[1680](#1680)                    } else {
[1681](#1681)                        self.palette.lane(noise)
[1682](#1682)                    };
[1683](#1683)                    set_styled_char(
[1684](#1684)                        buf,
[1685](#1685)                        x,
[1686](#1686)                        y,
[1687](#1687)                        if dist < 1.0 { '●' } else { '·' },
[1688](#1688)                        Style::default().fg(color).add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD),
[1689](#1689)                    );
[1690](#1690)                } else if (dist - 1.0).abs() < 0.5
[1691](#1691)                    || (dist - max_r * 0.5).abs() < 0.5
[1692](#1692)                    || (dist - max_r * 0.9).abs() < 0.5
[1693](#1693)                {
[1694](#1694)                    set_styled_char(buf, x, y, '·', Style::default().fg(self.palette.shadow));
[1695](#1695)                }
[1696](#1696)            }
[1697](#1697)        }
[1698](#1698)    }
[1699](#1699)}
[1700](#1700)

[1724](#1724)    pub fn new(count: u16) -> Self {
[1725](#1725)        Self {
[1726](#1726)            tick: 0,

[1735](#1735)    pub fn tick(mut self, tick: u64) -> Self {
[1736](#1736)        self.tick = tick;
[1737](#1737)        self
[1738](#1738)    }
[1739](#1739)
[1740](#1740)    #[must_use]
[1742](#1742)    pub fn palette(mut self, palette: AislingPalette) -> Self {
[1743](#1743)        self.palette = palette;
[1744](#1744)        self
[1745](#1745)    }
[1746](#1746)
[1747](#1747)    #[must_use]
[1749](#1749)    pub fn block(mut self, block: Block<'a>) -> Self {
[1750](#1750)        self.block = Some(block);
[1751](#1751)        self
[1752](#1752)    }
[1753](#1753)}
[1754](#1754)
[1755](#1755)impl Widget for OrbField<'_> {
[1756](#1756)    fn render(&self, buf: &mut Buffer, area: Rect) {
[1757](#1757)        let inner = self
[1758](#1758)            .block
[1759](#1759)            .as_ref()
[1760](#1760)            .map_or(area, |block| block_content_area(block, area));
[1761](#1761)        if let Some(block) = &self.block {
[1762](#1762)            block.render(buf, area);
[1763](#1763)        }
[1764](#1764)        if is_empty(inner) || self.count == 0 {
[1765](#1765)            return;
[1766](#1766)        }
[1767](#1767)
[1768](#1768)        for i in 0..u64::from(self.count) {
[1769](#1769)            let seed = field_noise(i as u16, i as u16 / 7, i);
[1770](#1770)            let speed_x = (seed % 7) as f64 * 0.3 + 0.2;
[1771](#1771)            let speed_y = ((seed >> 3) % 5) as f64 * 0.2 + 0.1;
[1772](#1772)            let phase_x = seed as f64 * 0.1;
[1773](#1773)            let phase_y = (seed >> 5) as f64 * 0.13;
[1774](#1774)
[1775](#1775)            let base_x = (inner.x as f64)
[1776](#1776)                + ((self.tick as f64 * speed_x * 0.02 + phase_x).sin() * 0.5 + 0.5)
[1777](#1777)                    * inner.width as f64;
[1778](#1778)            let base_y = (inner.y as f64)
[1779](#1779)                + ((self.tick as f64 * speed_y * 0.02 + phase_y).cos() * 0.5 + 0.5)
[1780](#1780)                    * inner.height as f64;
[1781](#1781)
[1782](#1782)            let px = base_x.round() as u16;
[1783](#1783)            let py = base_y.round() as u16;
[1784](#1784)
[1785](#1785)            if px >= inner.x
[1786](#1786)                && px < inner.x + inner.width
[1787](#1787)                && py >= inner.y
[1788](#1788)                && py < inner.y + inner.height
[1789](#1789)            {
[1790](#1790)                let noise = field_noise(px, py, self.tick + i);
[1791](#1791)                let glyph = if noise % 3 == 0 {
[1792](#1792)                    '◆'
[1793](#1793)                } else if noise % 3 == 1 {
[1794](#1794)                    '◇'
[1795](#1795)                } else {
[1796](#1796)                    '•'
[1797](#1797)                };
[1798](#1798)                set_styled_char(
[1799](#1799)                    buf,
[1800](#1800)                    px,
[1801](#1801)                    py,
[1802](#1802)                    glyph,
[1803](#1803)                    Style::default()
[1804](#1804)                        .fg(self.palette.lane(i))
[1805](#1805)                        .add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD),
[1806](#1806)                );
[1807](#1807)            }
[1808](#1808)        }
[1809](#1809)    }
[1810](#1810)}
[1811](#1811)

[1830](#1830)impl<'a> NeonBorder<'a> {
[1831](#1831)    #[must_use]
[1833](#1833)    pub fn new(inner: Block<'a>) -> Self {
[1834](#1834)        Self {
[1835](#1835)            tick: 0,
[1836](#1836)            speed: 3,
[1837](#1837)            palette: AislingPalette::dream(),
[1838](#1838)            inner,
[1839](#1839)        }
[1840](#1840)    }
[1841](#1841)
[1842](#1842)    #[must_use]
[1844](#1844)    pub fn tick(mut self, tick: u64) -> Self {
[1845](#1845)        self.tick = tick;
[1846](#1846)        self
[1847](#1847)    }
[1848](#1848)
[1849](#1849)    #[must_use]
[1851](#1851)    pub fn speed(mut self, speed: u64) -> Self {
[1852](#1852)        self.speed = speed.max(1);
[1853](#1853)        self
[1854](#1854)    }
[1855](#1855)
[1856](#1856)    #[must_use]
[1858](#1858)    pub fn palette(mut self, palette: AislingPalette) -> Self {
[1859](#1859)        self.palette = palette;
[1860](#1860)        self
[1861](#1861)    }
[1862](#1862)
[1863](#1863)    pub fn render_border(&self, buf: &mut Buffer, area: Rect) -> Rect {
[1865](#1865)        let inner = block_content_area(&self.inner, area);
[1866](#1866)
[1867](#1867)        let right = area.x.saturating_add(area.width);
[1868](#1868)        let bottom = area.y.saturating_add(area.height);
[1869](#1869)        let perimeter = 2 * (area.width + area.height) as u64;
[1870](#1870)
[1871](#1871)        for y in area.y..bottom {
[1872](#1872)            for x in area.x..right {
[1873](#1873)                if !is_edge(area, x, y) {
[1874](#1874)                    continue;
[1875](#1875)                }
[1876](#1876)
[1877](#1877)                let pos = if y == area.y {
[1878](#1878)                    u64::from(x - area.x)
[1879](#1879)                } else if x + 1 == right {
[1880](#1880)                    u64::from(area.width) + u64::from(y - area.y)
[1881](#1881)                } else if y + 1 == bottom {
[1882](#1882)                    u64::from(area.width + area.height) + u64::from(right - x - 1)
[1883](#1883)                } else {
[1884](#1884)                    u64::from(2 * area.width + area.height) + u64::from(bottom - y - 1)
[1885](#1885)                };
[1886](#1886)
[1887](#1887)                let phase = (self.tick * self.speed + pos) % perimeter;
[1888](#1888)                let color_idx = (phase * 4 / perimeter) as usize;
[1889](#1889)                let color = match color_idx {
[1890](#1890)                    0 => self.palette.low,
[1891](#1891)                    1 => self.palette.mid,
[1892](#1892)                    2 => self.palette.high,
[1893](#1893)                    _ => self.palette.pulse,
[1894](#1894)                };
[1895](#1895)
[1896](#1896)                let ch = if y == area.y || y + 1 == bottom {
[1897](#1897)                    '─'
[1898](#1898)                } else {
[1899](#1899)                    '│'
[1900](#1900)                };
[1901](#1901)                set_styled_char(
[1902](#1902)                    buf,
[1903](#1903)                    x,
[1904](#1904)                    y,
[1905](#1905)                    ch,
[1906](#1906)                    Style::default().fg(color).add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD),
[1907](#1907)                );
[1908](#1908)            }
[1909](#1909)        }
[1910](#1910)
[1911](#1911)        inner
[1912](#1912)    }
[1913](#1913)}

[1918](#1918)    }

[2048](#2048)    #[must_use]
[2050](#2050)    pub fn hit_regions(&self, id: impl Into<WidgetId>, area: Rect) -> Vec<HitRegion> {
[2051](#2051)        let region_id = id.into();
[2052](#2052)        let inner = self
[2053](#2053)            .block
[2054](#2054)            .as_ref()
[2055](#2055)            .map_or(area, |block| block_content_area(block, area));
[2056](#2056)        if is_empty(area) || is_empty(inner) {
[2057](#2057)            return Vec::new();
[2058](#2058)        }
[2059](#2059)
[2060](#2060)        let mut regions = vec![
[2061](#2061)            HitRegion::new(region_id.clone(), area)
[2062](#2062)                .with_role(WidgetRole::Transcript)
[2063](#2063)                .with_label("stream")
[2064](#2064)                .with_value(WidgetValue::Count(self.lines.len())),
[2065](#2065)        ];
[2066](#2066)        let start = self.visible_start(inner.height);
[2067](#2067)
[2068](#2068)        for row in 0..inner.height {
[2069](#2069)            let line_idx = start + row as usize;
[2070](#2070)            if line_idx >= self.lines.len() {
[2071](#2071)                break;
[2072](#2072)            }
[2073](#2073)
[2074](#2074)            let row_area = Rect::new(inner.x, inner.y + row, inner.width, 1);
[2075](#2075)            regions.push(
[2076](#2076)                HitRegion::new(format!("{}:line:{line_idx}", region_id.as_ref()), row_area)
[2077](#2077)                    .with_role(WidgetRole::TranscriptRow)
[2078](#2078)                    .with_label(self.lines[line_idx].as_ref())
[2079](#2079)                    .with_action(WidgetAction::Select)
[2080](#2080)                    .with_cursor(MouseCursor::Text)
[2081](#2081)                    .with_row(line_idx)
[2082](#2082)                    .with_value(WidgetValue::LineNumber(line_idx + 1))
[2083](#2083)                    .with_z_index(1),
[2084](#2084)            );
[2085](#2085)        }
[2086](#2086)
[2087](#2087)        regions
[2088](#2088)    }

[2090](#2090)    #[must_use]
[2092](#2092)    pub fn selectable_spans(&self, id: impl Into<WidgetId>, area: Rect) -> Vec<SelectableSpan> {
[2093](#2093)        let region_id = id.into();
[2094](#2094)        let inner = self
[2095](#2095)            .block
[2096](#2096)            .as_ref()
[2097](#2097)            .map_or(area, |block| block_content_area(block, area));
[2098](#2098)        if is_empty(inner) {
[2099](#2099)            return Vec::new();
[2100](#2100)        }
[2101](#2101)
[2102](#2102)        let gutter_width = self.gutter_width();
[2103](#2103)        let text_width = inner.width.saturating_sub(gutter_width);
[2104](#2104)        if text_width == 0 {
[2105](#2105)            return Vec::new();
[2106](#2106)        }
[2107](#2107)
[2108](#2108)        let group = SelectionGroup::new(format!("{}:lines", region_id.as_ref()));
[2109](#2109)        let start = self.visible_start(inner.height);
[2110](#2110)        let mut spans = Vec::new();
[2111](#2111)
[2112](#2112)        for row in 0..inner.height {
[2113](#2113)            let line_idx = start + row as usize;
[2114](#2114)            if line_idx >= self.lines.len() {
[2115](#2115)                break;
[2116](#2116)            }
[2117](#2117)
[2118](#2118)            let text = clipped_text(self.lines[line_idx].as_ref(), text_width);
[2119](#2119)            if text.is_empty() {
[2120](#2120)                continue;
[2121](#2121)            }
[2122](#2122)
[2123](#2123)            let width = text.chars().count().min(usize::from(text_width)) as u16;
[2124](#2124)            spans.push(
[2125](#2125)                SelectableSpan::from_logical(
[2126](#2126)                    format!("{}:span:{line_idx}", region_id.as_ref()),
[2127](#2127)                    region_id.clone(),
[2128](#2128)                    Rect::new(inner.x + gutter_width, inner.y + row, width, 1),
[2129](#2129)                    TextRange::new(line_idx, 0, width as usize),
[2130](#2130)                    text,
[2131](#2131)                )
[2132](#2132)                .with_group(group.clone()),
[2133](#2133)            );
[2134](#2134)        }
[2135](#2135)
[2136](#2136)        spans
[2137](#2137)    }
[2138](#2138)
[2139](#2139)    #[must_use]
[2141](#2141)    pub fn scroll_region(
[2142](#2142)        &self,

[2150](#2150)            .map_or(area, |block| block_content_area(block, area));
[2151](#2151)        if is_empty(inner) {
[2152](#2152)            return None;
[2153](#2153)        }
[2154](#2154)
[2155](#2155)        let start = self.visible_start(inner.height);
[2156](#2156)        let mut rows = Vec::new();
[2157](#2157)        for row in 0..inner.height {
[2158](#2158)            let line_idx = start + row as usize;
[2159](#2159)            if line_idx >= self.lines.len() {
[2160](#2160)                break;
[2161](#2161)            }

[2174](#2174)    #[must_use]
[2176](#2176)    pub fn line_count(&self) -> usize {
[2177](#2177)        self.lines.len()
[2178](#2178)    }
[2179](#2179)
[2180](#2180)    fn gutter_width(&self) -> u16 {
[2181](#2181)        if self.show_line_numbers {
[2182](#2182)            let max_num = self.lines.len().max(1);
[2183](#2183)            let digits = format!("{max_num}").len() as u16;
[2184](#2184)            digits + 1
[2185](#2185)        } else {
[2186](#2186)            0
[2187](#2187)        }
[2188](#2188)    }
[2189](#2189)
[2190](#2190)    fn visible_start(&self, visible_height: u16) -> usize {
[2192](#2192)        let total = self.lines.len() as u16;
[2193](#2193)        if self.follow_tail || self.scroll_offset == 0 {
[2194](#2194)            let shown = visible_height.min(total);
[2195](#2195)            (total - shown) as usize
[2196](#2196)        } else {
[2197](#2197)            let max_top = total.saturating_sub(visible_height);
[2198](#2198)            (max_top.saturating_sub(self.scroll_offset)) as usize
[2199](#2199)        }
[2200](#2200)    }

[2203](#2203)impl Default for StreamPanel<'_> {
[2204](#2204)    fn default() -> Self {
[2205](#2205)        Self::new()
[2206](#2206)    }
[2207](#2207)}
[2208](#2208)
[2209](#2209)impl Widget for StreamPanel<'_> {
[2210](#2210)    fn render(&self, buf: &mut Buffer, area: Rect) {
[2211](#2211)        let inner = self
[2212](#2212)            .block
[2213](#2213)            .as_ref()
[2214](#2214)            .map_or(area, |block| block_content_area(block, area));
[2215](#2215)        if let Some(block) = &self.block {
[2216](#2216)            block.render(buf, area);
[2217](#2217)        }
[2218](#2218)        if is_empty(inner) {
[2219](#2219)            return;
[2220](#2220)        }
[2221](#2221)
[2222](#2222)        let gutter_width = self.gutter_width();
[2223](#2223)
[2224](#2224)        let text_width = inner.width.saturating_sub(gutter_width);
[2225](#2225)        if text_width == 0 {
[2226](#2226)            return;
[2227](#2227)        }
[2228](#2228)
[2229](#2229)        let start = self.visible_start(inner.height);
[2230](#2230)        let right = inner.x.saturating_add(inner.width);
[2231](#2231)        let total = self.lines.len();
[2232](#2232)
[2233](#2233)        for row in 0..inner.height {
[2234](#2234)            let line_idx = start + row as usize;
[2235](#2235)            let y = inner.y + row;
[2236](#2236)
[2237](#2237)            if line_idx >= total {
[2238](#2238)                break;
[2239](#2239)            }
[2240](#2240)
[2241](#2241)            if self.show_line_numbers {
[2242](#2242)                let num_str = format!(
[2243](#2243)                    "{:>width$}",
[2244](#2244)                    line_idx + 1,
[2245](#2245)                    width = (gutter_width - 1) as usize
[2246](#2246)                );
[2247](#2247)                paint_text(
[2248](#2248)                    Rect::new(inner.x, y, gutter_width.saturating_sub(1), 1),
[2249](#2249)                    buf,
[2250](#2250)                    &num_str,
[2251](#2251)                    Style::default().fg(self.palette.shadow),
[2252](#2252)                );
[2253](#2253)                set_styled_char(
[2254](#2254)                    buf,
[2255](#2255)                    inner.x + gutter_width - 1,
[2256](#2256)                    y,
[2257](#2257)                    '│',
[2258](#2258)                    Style::default().fg(self.palette.shadow),
[2259](#2259)                );
[2260](#2260)            }
[2261](#2261)
[2262](#2262)            let line = &self.lines[line_idx];
[2263](#2263)            let text_chars: Vec<char> = line.chars().collect();
[2264](#2264)
[2265](#2265)            for col in 0..text_width {
[2266](#2266)                let x = inner.x + gutter_width + col;
[2267](#2267)                if x >= right {
[2268](#2268)                    break;
[2269](#2269)                }
[2270](#2270)                let ch = text_chars.get(col as usize).copied().unwrap_or(' ');
[2271](#2271)                let noise = field_noise(x, y, self.tick);
[2272](#2272)                let style = if ch == ' ' {
[2273](#2273)                    Style::default()
[2274](#2274)                } else if (noise + self.tick) % 31 == 0 {
[2275](#2275)                    Style::default()
[2276](#2276)                        .fg(self.palette.pulse)
[2277](#2277)                        .add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD)
[2278](#2278)                } else {
[2279](#2279)                    Style::default().fg(self.palette.high)
[2280](#2280)                };
[2281](#2281)                set_styled_char(buf, x, y, ch, style);
[2282](#2282)            }
[2283](#2283)        }
[2284](#2284)
[2285](#2285)        if !self.follow_tail && self.scroll_offset > 0 {
[2286](#2286)            let indicator_y = inner.y;
[2287](#2287)            let indicator_style = Style::default()
[2288](#2288)                .fg(self.palette.pulse)
[2289](#2289)                .add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD);
[2290](#2290)            if inner.width > 2 {
[2291](#2291)                set_styled_char(buf, right - 2, indicator_y, '▲', indicator_style);
[2292](#2292)            }
[2293](#2293)        }
[2294](#2294)    }
[2295](#2295)}

[2352](#2352)
[2353](#2353)    pub fn split(&self, area: Rect) -> (Rect, Rect, Rect) {
[2356](#2356)        if is_empty(area) {
[2357](#2357)            return (Rect::ZERO, Rect::ZERO, Rect::ZERO);
[2358](#2358)        }
[2359](#2359)
[2360](#2360)        match self.direction {
[2361](#2361)            SplitDirection::Vertical => {
[2362](#2362)                let has_divider = self.divider.is_some() && area.width > 1;
[2363](#2363)                let available = if has_divider {
[2364](#2364)                    area.width.saturating_sub(1)
[2365](#2365)                } else {
[2366](#2366)                    area.width
[2367](#2367)                };
[2368](#2368)                let first_width = (f64::from(available) * self.ratio).round() as u16;
[2369](#2369)                let second_width = available.saturating_sub(first_width);
[2370](#2370)
[2371](#2371)                let a = Rect::new(area.x, area.y, first_width, area.height);
[2372](#2372)                let div = if has_divider {
[2373](#2373)                    Rect::new(area.x + first_width, area.y, 1, area.height)
[2374](#2374)                } else {
[2375](#2375)                    Rect::ZERO
[2376](#2376)                };
[2377](#2377)                let b_x = area.x + first_width + if has_divider { 1 } else { 0 };
[2378](#2378)                let b = Rect::new(b_x, area.y, second_width, area.height);
[2379](#2379)                (a, b, div)
[2380](#2380)            }
[2381](#2381)            SplitDirection::Horizontal => {
[2382](#2382)                let has_divider = self.divider.is_some() && area.height > 1;
[2383](#2383)                let available = if has_divider {
[2384](#2384)                    area.height.saturating_sub(1)
[2385](#2385)                } else {
[2386](#2386)                    area.height
[2387](#2387)                };
[2388](#2388)                let first_height = (f64::from(available) * self.ratio).round() as u16;
[2389](#2389)                let second_height = available.saturating_sub(first_height);
[2390](#2390)
[2391](#2391)                let a = Rect::new(area.x, area.y, area.width, first_height);
[2392](#2392)                let div = if has_divider {
[2393](#2393)                    Rect::new(area.x, area.y + first_height, area.width, 1)
[2394](#2394)                } else {
[2395](#2395)                    Rect::ZERO
[2396](#2396)                };
[2397](#2397)                let b_y = area.y + first_height + if has_divider { 1 } else { 0 };
[2398](#2398)                let b = Rect::new(area.x, b_y, area.width, second_height);
[2399](#2399)                (a, b, div)
[2400](#2400)            }
[2401](#2401)        }
[2402](#2402)    }
[2403](#2403)
[2404](#2404)    pub fn render_divider(&self, buf: &mut Buffer, divider_area: Rect, palette: AislingPalette) {
[2406](#2406)        if is_empty(divider_area) {
[2407](#2407)            return;
[2408](#2408)        }
[2409](#2409)        let ch = self.divider.unwrap_or(' ');
[2410](#2410)        let style = Style::default().fg(palette.mid);
[2411](#2411)        for y in divider_area.y..divider_area.y.saturating_add(divider_area.height) {
[2412](#2412)            for x in divider_area.x..divider_area.x.saturating_add(divider_area.width) {
[2413](#2413)                set_styled_char(buf, x, y, ch, style);
[2414](#2414)            }
[2415](#2415)        }
[2416](#2416)    }

[2533](#2533)    #[must_use]
[2535](#2535)    pub fn hit_regions(&self, id: impl Into<WidgetId>, area: Rect) -> Vec<HitRegion> {
[2536](#2536)        let region_id = id.into();
[2537](#2537)        let inner = self
[2538](#2538)            .block
[2539](#2539)            .as_ref()
[2540](#2540)            .map_or(area, |block| block_content_area(block, area));
[2541](#2541)        if is_empty(area) || is_empty(inner) {
[2542](#2542)            return Vec::new();
[2543](#2543)        }
[2544](#2544)
[2545](#2545)        let mut regions = vec![
[2546](#2546)            HitRegion::new(region_id.clone(), area)
[2547](#2547)                .with_role(WidgetRole::Region)
[2548](#2548)                .with_label("list")
[2549](#2549)                .with_value(WidgetValue::Count(self.items.len())),
[2550](#2550)        ];
[2551](#2551)        let group = SelectionGroup::new(format!("{}:items", region_id.as_ref()));
[2552](#2552)        let start = self.visible_start(inner.height);
[2553](#2553)
[2554](#2554)        for row in 0..inner.height {
[2555](#2555)            let idx = start + row as usize;
[2556](#2556)            if idx >= self.items.len() {
[2557](#2557)                break;
[2558](#2558)            }
[2559](#2559)
[2560](#2560)            let selected = self.selected == Some(idx);
[2561](#2561)            let row_area = Rect::new(inner.x, inner.y + row, inner.width, 1);
[2562](#2562)            regions.push(
[2563](#2563)                HitRegion::new(format!("{}:item:{idx}", region_id.as_ref()), row_area)
[2564](#2564)                    .with_role(WidgetRole::ListItem)
[2565](#2565)                    .with_label(self.items[idx].as_ref())
[2566](#2566)                    .with_action(WidgetAction::Focus)
[2567](#2567)                    .with_cursor(MouseCursor::Pointer)
[2568](#2568)                    .with_row(idx)
[2569](#2569)                    .with_selection_group(group.clone())
[2570](#2570)                    .with_state(WidgetState::default().selected(selected))
[2571](#2571)                    .with_z_index(1),
[2572](#2572)            );
[2573](#2573)        }
[2574](#2574)
[2575](#2575)        regions
[2576](#2576)    }
[2577](#2577)
[2578](#2578)    #[must_use]
[2580](#2580)    pub fn selectable_spans(&self, id: impl Into<WidgetId>, area: Rect) -> Vec<SelectableSpan> {
[2581](#2581)        let region_id = id.into();
[2582](#2582)        let inner = self
[2583](#2583)            .block
[2584](#2584)            .as_ref()
[2585](#2585)            .map_or(area, |block| block_content_area(block, area));
[2586](#2586)        if is_empty(inner) {
[2587](#2587)            return Vec::new();
[2588](#2588)        }
[2589](#2589)
[2590](#2590)        let text_x = inner.x.saturating_add(2);
[2591](#2591)        let text_width = inner.width.saturating_sub(2);
[2592](#2592)        if text_width == 0 {
[2593](#2593)            return Vec::new();
[2594](#2594)        }
[2595](#2595)
[2596](#2596)        let group = SelectionGroup::new(format!("{}:items", region_id.as_ref()));
[2597](#2597)        let start = self.visible_start(inner.height);
[2598](#2598)        let mut spans = Vec::new();
[2599](#2599)
[2600](#2600)        for row in 0..inner.height {
[2601](#2601)            let item_idx = start + row as usize;
[2602](#2602)            if item_idx >= self.items.len() {
[2603](#2603)                break;
[2604](#2604)            }
[2605](#2605)
[2606](#2606)            let text = clipped_text(self.items[item_idx].as_ref(), text_width);
[2607](#2607)            if text.is_empty() {
[2608](#2608)                continue;
[2609](#2609)            }
[2610](#2610)
[2611](#2611)            let width = text.chars().count().min(usize::from(text_width)) as u16;
[2612](#2612)            spans.push(
[2613](#2613)                SelectableSpan::from_logical(
[2614](#2614)                    format!("{}:span:{item_idx}", region_id.as_ref()),
[2615](#2615)                    region_id.clone(),
[2616](#2616)                    Rect::new(text_x, inner.y + row, width, 1),
[2617](#2617)                    TextRange::new(item_idx, 0, width as usize),
[2618](#2618)                    text,
[2619](#2619)                )
[2620](#2620)                .with_group(group.clone()),
[2621](#2621)            );
[2622](#2622)        }
[2623](#2623)
[2624](#2624)        spans
[2625](#2625)    }
[2626](#2626)
[2627](#2627)    #[must_use]
[2629](#2629)    pub fn scroll_region(
[2630](#2630)        &self,
[2631](#2631)        id: impl Into<WidgetId>,
[2632](#2632)        area: Rect,
[2633](#2633)    ) -> Option<(Rect, usize, Vec<ScrollRowHit>)> {
[2634](#2634)        let region_id = id.into();
[2635](#2635)        let inner = self
[2636](#2636)            .block
[2637](#2637)            .as_ref()
[2638](#2638)            .map_or(area, |block| block_content_area(block, area));
[2639](#2639)        if is_empty(inner) {
[2640](#2640)            return None;
[2641](#2641)        }
[2642](#2642)
[2643](#2643)        let start = self.visible_start(inner.height);
[2644](#2644)        let mut rows = Vec::new();
[2645](#2645)        for row in 0..inner.height {
[2646](#2646)            let item_idx = start + row as usize;
[2647](#2647)            if item_idx >= self.items.len() {
[2648](#2648)                break;
[2649](#2649)            }
[2650](#2650)            let row_id = WidgetId::new(format!("{}:item:{item_idx}", region_id.as_ref()));
[2651](#2651)            rows.push(
[2652](#2652)                ScrollRowHit::new(row_id.clone(), item_idx)
[2653](#2653)                    .with_span_id(format!("{}:span:{item_idx}", region_id.as_ref()))
[2654](#2654)                    .with_item_id(row_id),
[2655](#2655)            );
[2656](#2656)        }
[2657](#2657)
[2658](#2658)        Some((inner, start, rows))
[2659](#2659)    }

[2661](#2661)    #[must_use]
[2663](#2663)    pub fn item_count(&self) -> usize {

[2665](#2665)    }
[2666](#2666)
[2667](#2667)    fn visible_start(&self, visible_height: u16) -> usize {
[2668](#2668)        let total = self.items.len() as u16;
[2669](#2669)        if let Some(sel) = self.selected {
[2670](#2670)            let sel = sel as u16;
[2671](#2671)            if sel < self.scroll_offset {
[2672](#2672)                return sel as usize;
[2673](#2673)            }
[2674](#2674)            if sel >= self.scroll_offset + visible_height {
[2675](#2675)                return (sel + 1 - visible_height) as usize;
[2676](#2676)            }
[2677](#2677)            return self.scroll_offset as usize;
[2678](#2678)        }
[2679](#2679)        let max_top = total.saturating_sub(visible_height);
[2680](#2680)        (self.scroll_offset.min(max_top)) as usize
[2681](#2681)    }

[2690](#2690)impl Widget for List<'_> {
[2691](#2691)    fn render(&self, buf: &mut Buffer, area: Rect) {
[2692](#2692)        let inner = self
[2693](#2693)            .block
[2694](#2694)            .as_ref()
[2695](#2695)            .map_or(area, |block| block_content_area(block, area));
[2696](#2696)        if let Some(block) = &self.block {
[2697](#2697)            block.render(buf, area);
[2698](#2698)        }
[2699](#2699)        if is_empty(inner) {
[2700](#2700)            return;
[2701](#2701)        }
[2702](#2702)
[2703](#2703)        let start = self.visible_start(inner.height);
[2704](#2704)        let indicator_width = 2u16;
[2705](#2705)        let text_width = inner.width.saturating_sub(indicator_width);
[2706](#2706)
[2707](#2707)        for row in 0..inner.height {
[2708](#2708)            let idx = start + row as usize;
[2709](#2709)            let y = inner.y + row;
[2710](#2710)
[2711](#2711)            if idx >= self.items.len() {
[2712](#2712)                break;
[2713](#2713)            }
[2714](#2714)
[2715](#2715)            let is_selected = self.selected == Some(idx);
[2716](#2716)
[2717](#2717)            let indicator = if is_selected { "▸ " } else { "  " };
[2718](#2718)            let indicator_style = if is_selected {
[2719](#2719)                Style::default()
[2720](#2720)                    .fg(self.palette.pulse)
[2721](#2721)                    .add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD)
[2722](#2722)            } else {
[2723](#2723)                Style::default().fg(self.palette.shadow)
[2724](#2724)            };
[2725](#2725)            paint_text(
[2726](#2726)                Rect::new(inner.x, y, indicator_width, 1),
[2727](#2727)                buf,
[2728](#2728)                indicator,
[2729](#2729)                indicator_style,
[2730](#2730)            );
[2731](#2731)
[2732](#2732)            let item = &self.items[idx];
[2733](#2733)            let item_chars: Vec<char> = item.chars().collect();
[2734](#2734)
[2735](#2735)            for col in 0..text_width {
[2736](#2736)                let x = inner.x + indicator_width + col;
[2737](#2737)                let ch = item_chars.get(col as usize).copied().unwrap_or(' ');
[2738](#2738)                let style = if is_selected {
[2739](#2739)                    if ch == ' ' {
[2740](#2740)                        Style::default().bg(self.palette.shadow)
[2741](#2741)                    } else {
[2742](#2742)                        Style::default()
[2743](#2743)                            .fg(self.palette.high)
[2744](#2744)                            .bg(self.palette.shadow)
[2745](#2745)                            .add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD)
[2746](#2746)                    }
[2747](#2747)                } else if ch == ' ' {
[2748](#2748)                    Style::default()
[2749](#2749)                } else {
[2750](#2750)                    Style::default().fg(self.palette.high)
[2751](#2751)                };
[2752](#2752)                set_styled_char(buf, x, y, ch, style);
[2753](#2753)            }
[2754](#2754)        }
[2755](#2755)    }

[2829](#2829)        &self,

[2842](#2842)    #[must_use]
[2844](#2844)    pub fn hit_regions(&self, id: impl Into<WidgetId>, area: Rect) -> Vec<HitRegion> {
[2845](#2845)        let region_id = id.into();
[2846](#2846)        let inner = self
[2847](#2847)            .block
[2848](#2848)            .as_ref()
[2849](#2849)            .map_or(area, |block| block_content_area(block, area));
[2850](#2850)        if is_empty(area) || is_empty(inner) {
[2851](#2851)            return Vec::new();
[2852](#2852)        }
[2853](#2853)
[2854](#2854)        let mut regions = vec![
[2855](#2855)            HitRegion::new(region_id.clone(), area)
[2856](#2856)                .with_role(WidgetRole::Region)
[2857](#2857)                .with_label("tabs")
[2858](#2858)                .with_value(WidgetValue::Count(self.tabs.len())),
[2859](#2859)        ];
[2860](#2860)        let mut x = inner.x;
[2861](#2861)        let right = inner.x.saturating_add(inner.width);
[2862](#2862)
[2863](#2863)        for (idx, tab) in self.tabs.iter().enumerate() {
[2864](#2864)            if x >= right {
[2865](#2865)                break;
[2866](#2866)            }
[2867](#2867)
[2868](#2868)            let label_width = tab.chars().count() as u16;
[2869](#2869)            let tab_width = label_width.saturating_add(4).min(right - x);
[2870](#2870)            if tab_width == 0 {
[2871](#2871)                break;
[2872](#2872)            }
[2873](#2873)
[2874](#2874)            regions.push(
[2875](#2875)                HitRegion::new(
[2876](#2876)                    format!("{}:tab:{idx}", region_id.as_ref()),
[2877](#2877)                    Rect::new(x, inner.y, tab_width, 1),
[2878](#2878)                )
[2879](#2879)                .with_role(WidgetRole::Tab)
[2880](#2880)                .with_label(tab.as_ref())
[2881](#2881)                .with_action(WidgetAction::Focus)
[2882](#2882)                .with_cursor(MouseCursor::Pointer)
[2883](#2883)                .with_row(idx)
[2884](#2884)                .with_shortcut(format!("{}", idx + 1))
[2885](#2885)                .with_state(WidgetState::default().selected(idx == self.selected))
[2886](#2886)                .with_z_index(1),
[2887](#2887)            );
[2888](#2888)
[2889](#2889)            x = x.saturating_add(tab_width);
[2890](#2890)        }
[2891](#2891)
[2892](#2892)        regions
[2893](#2893)    }
[2894](#2894)
[2895](#2895)    #[must_use]
[2897](#2897)    pub fn tab_count(&self) -> usize {
[2898](#2898)        self.tabs.len()
[2899](#2899)    }

[2901](#2901)
[2902](#2902)impl Widget for TabBar<'_> {
[2903](#2903)    fn render(&self, buf: &mut Buffer, area: Rect) {
[2904](#2904)        let inner = self
[2905](#2905)            .block
[2906](#2906)            .as_ref()
[2907](#2907)            .map_or(area, |block| block_content_area(block, area));
[2908](#2908)        if let Some(block) = &self.block {
[2909](#2909)            block.render(buf, area);
[2910](#2910)        }
[2911](#2911)        if is_empty(inner) {
[2912](#2912)            return;
[2913](#2913)        }
[2914](#2914)
[2915](#2915)        let mut x = inner.x;
[2916](#2916)        let right = inner.x.saturating_add(inner.width);
[2917](#2917)
[2918](#2918)        for (i, tab) in self.tabs.iter().enumerate() {
[2919](#2919)            if x >= right {
[2920](#2920)                break;
[2921](#2921)            }
[2922](#2922)
[2923](#2923)            let is_selected = i == self.selected;
[2924](#2924)            let label: Vec<char> = tab.chars().collect();
[2925](#2925)            let padding = 2u16;
[2926](#2926)            let tab_width = (label.len() as u16 + padding * 2).min(right - x);
[2927](#2927)
[2928](#2928)            if is_selected {
[2929](#2929)                set_styled_char(
[2930](#2930)                    buf,
[2931](#2931)                    x,
[2932](#2932)                    inner.y,
[2933](#2933)                    '㎍',
[2934](#2934)                    Style::default()
[2935](#2935)                        .fg(self.palette.pulse)
[2936](#2936)                        .add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD),
[2937](#2937)                );
[2938](#2938)            } else {
[2939](#2939)                set_styled_char(buf, x, inner.y, ' ', Style::default());
[2940](#2940)            }
[2941](#2941)
[2942](#2942)            for col in 0..tab_width {
[2943](#2943)                let cx = x + col;
[2944](#2944)                if cx >= right {
[2945](#2945)                    break;
[2946](#2946)                }
[2947](#2947)
[2948](#2948)                let char_idx = col.saturating_sub(padding) as usize;
[2949](#2949)                let ch = if col < padding || col >= tab_width - padding {
[2950](#2950)                    ' '
[2951](#2951)                } else if char_idx < label.len() {
[2952](#2952)                    label[char_idx]
[2953](#2953)                } else {
[2954](#2954)                    ' '
[2955](#2955)                };
[2956](#2956)
[2957](#2957)                let style = if is_selected {
[2958](#2958)                    Style::default()
[2959](#2959)                        .fg(self.palette.high)
[2960](#2960)                        .add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD)
[2961](#2961)                } else {
[2962](#2962)                    Style::default().fg(self.palette.mid)
[2963](#2963)                };
[2964](#2964)                set_styled_char(buf, cx, inner.y, ch, style);
[2965](#2965)            }
[2966](#2966)
[2967](#2967)            if is_selected {
[2968](#2968)                let bottom = inner.y + inner.height.saturating_sub(1);
[2969](#2969)                for col in 0..tab_width {
[2970](#2970)                    let cx = x + col;
[2971](#2971)                    if cx >= right {
[2972](#2972)                        break;
[2973](#2973)                    }
[2974](#2974)                    set_styled_char(
[2975](#2975)                        buf,
[2976](#2976)                        cx,
[2977](#2977)                        bottom,
[2978](#2978)                        '─',
[2979](#2979)                        Style::default().fg(self.palette.pulse),
[2980](#2980)                    );
[2981](#2981)                }
[2982](#2982)            }
[2983](#2983)
[2984](#2984)            x += tab_width;
[2985](#2985)        }
[2986](#2986)    }

[3128](#3128)    #[must_use]
[3130](#3130)    pub fn hit_regions(&self, id: impl Into<WidgetId>, area: Rect) -> Vec<HitRegion> {
[3131](#3131)        let region_id = id.into();
[3132](#3132)        let inner = self
[3133](#3133)            .block
[3134](#3134)            .as_ref()
[3135](#3135)            .map_or(area, |block| block_content_area(block, area));
[3136](#3136)        if is_empty(area) || is_empty(inner) {
[3137](#3137)            return Vec::new();
[3138](#3138)        }
[3139](#3139)
[3140](#3140)        let mut regions = vec![
[3141](#3141)            HitRegion::new(region_id.clone(), area)
[3142](#3142)                .with_role(WidgetRole::Region)
[3143](#3143)                .with_label("table")
[3144](#3144)                .with_value(WidgetValue::Count(self.rows.len())),
[3145](#3145)        ];
[3146](#3146)        if self.headers.is_empty() || inner.height < 3 {
[3147](#3147)            return regions;
[3148](#3148)        }
[3149](#3149)
[3150](#3150)        let visible_rows = inner.height.saturating_sub(2);
[3151](#3151)        let start = self
[3152](#3152)            .scroll_offset
[3153](#3153)            .min((self.rows.len() as u16).saturating_sub(visible_rows.min(self.rows.len() as u16)));
[3154](#3154)

[3156](#3156)            let row_idx = start as usize + row_offset as usize;
[3157](#3157)            if row_idx >= self.rows.len() {
[3158](#3158)                break;

[3160](#3160)

[3163](#3163)            let label = self.rows[row_idx]
[3164](#3164)                .iter()

[3166](#3166)                .collect::<Vec<_>>()

[3169](#3169)                HitRegion::new(

[3171](#3171)                    Rect::new(inner.x, y, inner.width, 1),
[3172](#3172)                )
[3173](#3173)                .with_role(WidgetRole::ModelRow)
[3174](#3174)                .with_label(label)
[3175](#3175)                .with_action(WidgetAction::Focus)
[3176](#3176)                .with_cursor(MouseCursor::Pointer)
[3177](#3177)                .with_row(row_idx)
[3178](#3178)                .with_state(WidgetState::default().selected(selected))
[3179](#3179)                .with_value(WidgetValue::Count(self.rows[row_idx].len()))

[3187](#3187)    #[must_use]
[3189](#3189)    pub fn selectable_spans(&self, id: impl Into<WidgetId>, area: Rect) -> Vec<SelectableSpan> {
[3190](#3190)        let region_id = id.into();
[3191](#3191)        let inner = self
[3192](#3192)            .block
[3193](#3193)            .as_ref()
[3194](#3194)            .map_or(area, |block| block_content_area(block, area));
[3195](#3195)        let Some((viewport, start, _)) = self.scroll_region(region_id.clone(), area) else {
[3196](#3196)            return Vec::new();
[3197](#3197)        };
[3198](#3198)        if self.headers.is_empty() || is_empty(inner) || is_empty(viewport) {
[3199](#3199)            return Vec::new();
[3200](#3200)        }
[3201](#3201)
[3202](#3202)        let group = SelectionGroup::new(format!("{}:rows", region_id.as_ref()));
[3203](#3203)        let mut spans = Vec::new();
[3204](#3204)        for row_offset in 0..viewport.height {
[3205](#3205)            let row_idx = start + row_offset as usize;
[3206](#3206)            if row_idx >= self.rows.len() {
[3207](#3207)                break;
[3208](#3208)            }
[3209](#3209)
[3210](#3210)            let text = clipped_text(&self.row_label(row_idx), viewport.width);
[3211](#3211)            if text.is_empty() {
[3212](#3212)                continue;
[3213](#3213)            }
[3214](#3214)
[3215](#3215)            let width = text.chars().count().min(usize::from(viewport.width)) as u16;
[3216](#3216)            spans.push(
[3217](#3217)                SelectableSpan::from_logical(
[3218](#3218)                    format!("{}:span:{row_idx}", region_id.as_ref()),
[3219](#3219)                    region_id.clone(),
[3220](#3220)                    Rect::new(viewport.x, viewport.y + row_offset, width, 1),
[3221](#3221)                    TextRange::new(row_idx, 0, width as usize),
[3222](#3222)                    text,
[3223](#3223)                )
[3224](#3224)                .with_group(group.clone()),
[3225](#3225)            );
[3226](#3226)        }
[3227](#3227)
[3228](#3228)        spans
[3229](#3229)    }
[3230](#3230)
[3231](#3231)    #[must_use]
[3233](#3233)    pub fn scroll_region(
[3234](#3234)        &self,
[3235](#3235)        id: impl Into<WidgetId>,
[3236](#3236)        area: Rect,
[3237](#3237)    ) -> Option<(Rect, usize, Vec<ScrollRowHit>)> {
[3238](#3238)        let region_id = id.into();
[3239](#3239)        let inner = self
[3240](#3240)            .block
[3241](#3241)            .as_ref()
[3242](#3242)            .map_or(area, |block| block_content_area(block, area));
[3243](#3243)        if self.headers.is_empty() || inner.height < 3 || is_empty(inner) {
[3244](#3244)            return None;
[3245](#3245)        }
[3246](#3246)
[3247](#3247)        let visible_rows = inner.height.saturating_sub(2);
[3248](#3248)        let viewport = Rect::new(inner.x, inner.y + 2, inner.width, visible_rows);
[3249](#3249)        if is_empty(viewport) {
[3250](#3250)            return None;
[3251](#3251)        }
[3252](#3252)
[3253](#3253)        let total = self.rows.len() as u16;
[3254](#3254)        let start = self
[3255](#3255)            .scroll_offset
[3256](#3256)            .min(total.saturating_sub(visible_rows.min(total))) as usize;
[3257](#3257)        let mut rows = Vec::new();
[3258](#3258)        for row_offset in 0..visible_rows {
[3259](#3259)            let row_idx = start + row_offset as usize;
[3260](#3260)            if row_idx >= self.rows.len() {
[3261](#3261)                break;
[3262](#3262)            }
[3263](#3263)            let row_id = WidgetId::new(format!("{}:row:{row_idx}", region_id.as_ref()));
[3264](#3264)            rows.push(
[3265](#3265)                ScrollRowHit::new(row_id.clone(), row_idx)
[3266](#3266)                    .with_span_id(format!("{}:span:{row_idx}", region_id.as_ref()))
[3267](#3267)                    .with_item_id(row_id),
[3268](#3268)            );
[3269](#3269)        }
[3270](#3270)
[3271](#3271)        Some((viewport, start, rows))
[3272](#3272)    }
[3273](#3273)
[3274](#3274)    #[must_use]
[3276](#3276)    pub fn row_count(&self) -> usize {
[3277](#3277)        self.rows.len()
[3278](#3278)    }
[3279](#3279)
[3280](#3280)    fn row_label(&self, row_idx: usize) -> String {
[3281](#3281)        self.rows[row_idx]
[3282](#3282)            .iter()
[3283](#3283)            .map(Cow::as_ref)
[3284](#3284)            .collect::<Vec<_>>()
[3285](#3285)            .join(" | ")
[3286](#3286)    }
[3287](#3287)
[3288](#3288)    fn compute_widths(&self, total_width: u16) -> Vec<u16> {
[3289](#3289)        if let Some(ref w) = self.widths {
[3290](#3290)            return w.clone();
[3291](#3291)        }
[3292](#3292)        let cols = self.headers.len().max(1) as u16;
[3293](#3293)        let per_col = total_width / cols;
[3294](#3294)        let mut widths = vec![per_col; cols as usize];
[3295](#3295)        let remainder = total_width.saturating_sub(per_col * cols);
[3296](#3296)        for w in widths.iter_mut().take(remainder as usize) {
[3297](#3297)            *w += 1;
[3298](#3298)        }
[3299](#3299)        widths
[3300](#3300)    }

[3302](#3302)
[3303](#3303)impl Widget for Table<'_> {
[3304](#3304)    fn render(&self, buf: &mut Buffer, area: Rect) {
[3305](#3305)        let inner = self
[3306](#3306)            .block
[3307](#3307)            .as_ref()
[3308](#3308)            .map_or(area, |block| block_content_area(block, area));
[3309](#3309)        if let Some(block) = &self.block {
[3310](#3310)            block.render(buf, area);
[3311](#3311)        }
[3312](#3312)        if is_empty(inner) || self.headers.is_empty() {
[3313](#3313)            return;
[3314](#3314)        }
[3315](#3315)
[3316](#3316)        let col_widths = self.compute_widths(inner.width);
[3317](#3317)        let header_height = 1u16;
[3318](#3318)        let divider_height = 1u16;
[3319](#3319)        let data_start_y = inner.y + header_height + divider_height;
[3320](#3320)        let visible_rows = inner.height.saturating_sub(header_height + divider_height);
[3321](#3321)
[3322](#3322)        for (col_idx, header) in self.headers.iter().enumerate() {
[3323](#3323)            if col_idx >= col_widths.len() {
[3324](#3324)                break;
[3325](#3325)            }
[3326](#3326)            let col_x = inner.x + col_widths[..col_idx].iter().sum::<u16>();
[3327](#3327)            let w = col_widths[col_idx];
[3328](#3328)            paint_text(
[3329](#3329)                Rect::new(col_x, inner.y, w, 1),
[3330](#3330)                buf,
[3331](#3331)                header.as_ref(),
[3332](#3332)                Style::default()
[3333](#3333)                    .fg(self.palette.pulse)
[3334](#3334)                    .add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD),
[3335](#3335)            );
[3336](#3336)        }
[3337](#3337)
[3338](#3338)        let div_y = inner.y + header_height;
[3339](#3339)        for col_idx in 0..self.headers.len().min(col_widths.len()) {
[3340](#3340)            let col_x = inner.x + col_widths[..col_idx].iter().sum::<u16>();
[3341](#3341)            let w = col_widths[col_idx];
[3342](#3342)            for dx in 0..w {
[3343](#3343)                set_styled_char(
[3344](#3344)                    buf,
[3345](#3345)                    col_x + dx,
[3346](#3346)                    div_y,
[3347](#3347)                    '─',
[3348](#3348)                    Style::default().fg(self.palette.shadow),
[3349](#3349)                );
[3350](#3350)            }
[3351](#3351)        }
[3352](#3352)
[3353](#3353)        let total = self.rows.len() as u16;
[3354](#3354)        let start = self
[3355](#3355)            .scroll_offset
[3356](#3356)            .min(total.saturating_sub(visible_rows.min(total)));
[3357](#3357)
[3358](#3358)        for row_offset in 0..visible_rows {
[3359](#3359)            let row_idx = start as usize + row_offset as usize;
[3360](#3360)            let y = data_start_y + row_offset;
[3361](#3361)
[3362](#3362)            if row_idx >= self.rows.len() {
[3363](#3363)                break;
[3364](#3364)            }
[3365](#3365)
[3366](#3366)            let is_selected = self.selected == Some(row_idx);
[3367](#3367)            let row = &self.rows[row_idx];
[3368](#3368)
[3369](#3369)            for (col_idx, cell) in row.iter().enumerate() {
[3370](#3370)                if col_idx >= col_widths.len() {
[3371](#3371)                    break;
[3372](#3372)                }
[3373](#3373)                let col_x = inner.x + col_widths[..col_idx].iter().sum::<u16>();
[3374](#3374)                let w = col_widths[col_idx];
[3375](#3375)
[3376](#3376)                let cell_chars: Vec<char> = cell.chars().collect();
[3377](#3377)                for dx in 0..w {
[3378](#3378)                    let ch = cell_chars.get(dx as usize).copied().unwrap_or(' ');
[3379](#3379)                    let style = if is_selected {
[3380](#3380)                        Style::default()
[3381](#3381)                            .fg(self.palette.high)
[3382](#3382)                            .bg(self.palette.shadow)
[3383](#3383)                            .add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD)
[3384](#3384)                    } else {
[3385](#3385)                        Style::default().fg(self.palette.high)
[3386](#3386)                    };
[3387](#3387)                    set_styled_char(buf, col_x + dx, y, ch, style);
[3388](#3388)                }
[3389](#3389)            }
[3390](#3390)        }
[3391](#3391)    }
[3392](#3392)}
[3393](#3393)

[3450](#3450)impl Widget for Sparkline<'_> {
[3451](#3451)    fn render(&self, buf: &mut Buffer, area: Rect) {
[3452](#3452)        let inner = self
[3453](#3453)            .block
[3454](#3454)            .as_ref()
[3455](#3455)            .map_or(area, |block| block_content_area(block, area));
[3456](#3456)        if let Some(block) = &self.block {
[3457](#3457)            block.render(buf, area);
[3458](#3458)        }
[3459](#3459)        if is_empty(inner) || self.data.is_empty() {
[3460](#3460)            return;
[3461](#3461)        }
[3462](#3462)
[3463](#3463)        let max = self
[3464](#3464)            .max_value
[3465](#3465)            .unwrap_or_else(|| self.data.iter().copied().max().unwrap_or(1))
[3466](#3466)            .max(1);
[3467](#3467)        let bottom = inner.y.saturating_add(inner.height);
[3468](#3468)
[3469](#3469)        for col in 0..inner.width {
[3470](#3470)            let data_idx = (col as usize * self.data.len()) / usize::from(inner.width);
[3471](#3471)            let value = self.data.get(data_idx).copied().unwrap_or(0);
[3472](#3472)            let bar_height =
[3473](#3473)                ((f64::from(value) / f64::from(max)) * f64::from(inner.height)).round() as u16;
[3474](#3474)            let bar_y = bottom.saturating_sub(bar_height);
[3475](#3475)
[3476](#3476)            for y in bar_y..bottom {
[3477](#3477)                let noise = field_noise(inner.x + col, y, 0);
[3478](#3478)                let style = Style::default()
[3479](#3479)                    .fg(self.palette.lane(noise))
[3480](#3480)                    .add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD);
[3481](#3481)                set_styled_char(buf, inner.x + col, y, '█', style);
[3482](#3482)            }
[3483](#3483)
[3484](#3484)            for y in inner.y..bar_y {
[3485](#3485)                set_styled_char(
[3486](#3486)                    buf,
[3487](#3487)                    inner.x + col,
[3488](#3488)                    y,
[3489](#3489)                    '·',
[3490](#3490)                    Style::default().fg(self.palette.shadow),
[3491](#3491)                );
[3492](#3492)            }
[3493](#3493)        }
[3494](#3494)    }

[3561](#3561)        let inner = self
[3562](#3562)            .block
[3563](#3563)            .as_ref()
[3564](#3564)            .map_or(area, |block| block_content_area(block, area));
[3565](#3565)        if let Some(block) = &self.block {

[3568](#3568)        if is_empty(inner) {

[3572](#3572)        let right = inner.x.saturating_add(inner.width);
[3573](#3573)        let bottom = inner.y.saturating_add(inner.height);
[3574](#3574)        let filled = (f64::from(inner.width) * self.ratio).round() as u16;
[3575](#3575)
[3576](#3576)        for y in inner.y..bottom {
[3577](#3577)            for x in inner.x..right {
[3578](#3578)                let offset = x.saturating_sub(inner.x);
[3579](#3579)                if offset < filled {

[3588](#3588)                    );
[3589](#3589)                } else {
[3590](#3590)                    set_styled_char(buf, x, y, '░', Style::default().fg(self.palette.shadow));
[3591](#3591)                }
[3592](#3592)            }
[3593](#3593)        }
[3594](#3594)
[3595](#3595)        if let Some(label) = &self.label {
[3596](#3596)            let row = inner.y + inner.height / 2;
[3597](#3597)            let label_width = label.chars().count().min(usize::from(inner.width)) as u16;
[3598](#3598)            let start = inner.x + inner.width.saturating_sub(label_width) / 2;
[3599](#3599)            paint_text(
[3600](#3600)                Rect::new(start, row, label_width, 1),
[3601](#3601)                buf,

[3603](#3603)                Style::default()
[3604](#3604)                    .fg(self.palette.high)

[3632](#3632)
[3633](#3633)impl<'a> Paragraph<'a> {
[3634](#3634)    #[must_use]
[3636](#3636)    pub fn new(text: impl Into<Cow<'a, str>>) -> Self {
[3637](#3637)        Self {
[3638](#3638)            text: text.into(),
[3639](#3639)            scroll_offset: 0,
[3640](#3640)            palette: AislingPalette::cypherpunk(),
[3641](#3641)            block: None,
[3642](#3642)        }
[3643](#3643)    }
[3644](#3644)
[3645](#3645)    #[must_use]
[3647](#3647)    pub fn scroll_offset(mut self, offset: u16) -> Self {
[3648](#3648)        self.scroll_offset = offset;
[3649](#3649)        self
[3650](#3650)    }
[3651](#3651)
[3652](#3652)    #[must_use]
[3654](#3654)    pub fn palette(mut self, palette: AislingPalette) -> Self {
[3655](#3655)        self.palette = palette;
[3656](#3656)        self
[3657](#3657)    }
[3658](#3658)
[3659](#3659)    #[must_use]
[3661](#3661)    pub fn block(mut self, block: Block<'a>) -> Self {
[3662](#3662)        self.block = Some(block);
[3663](#3663)        self
[3664](#3664)    }
[3665](#3665)
[3666](#3666)    fn wrap_lines(&self, width: u16) -> Vec<Cow<'_, str>> {
[3667](#3667)        if width == 0 {
[3668](#3668)            return Vec::new();
[3669](#3669)        }
[3670](#3670)        let mut result = Vec::new();
[3671](#3671)        for raw_line in self.text.lines() {
[3672](#3672)            if raw_line.is_empty() {
[3673](#3673)                result.push(Cow::Borrowed(""));
[3674](#3674)                continue;
[3675](#3675)            }
[3676](#3676)            let mut remaining = raw_line;
[3677](#3677)            while !remaining.is_empty() {
[3678](#3678)                let w = usize::from(width);
[3679](#3679)                if remaining.len() <= w {
[3680](#3680)                    result.push(Cow::Borrowed(remaining));
[3681](#3681)                    break;
[3682](#3682)                }
[3683](#3683)                let break_at = remaining[..w].rfind(' ').map(|p| p + 1).unwrap_or(w);
[3684](#3684)                result.push(Cow::Borrowed(&remaining[..break_at]));
[3685](#3685)                remaining = &remaining[break_at..];
[3686](#3686)            }
[3687](#3687)        }
[3688](#3688)        result
[3689](#3689)    }
[3690](#3690)}
[3691](#3691)
[3692](#3692)impl Widget for Paragraph<'_> {
[3693](#3693)    fn render(&self, buf: &mut Buffer, area: Rect) {
[3694](#3694)        let inner = self
[3695](#3695)            .block
[3696](#3696)            .as_ref()
[3697](#3697)            .map_or(area, |block| block_content_area(block, area));
[3698](#3698)        if let Some(block) = &self.block {
[3699](#3699)            block.render(buf, area);
[3700](#3700)        }
[3701](#3701)        if is_empty(inner) {
[3702](#3702)            return;
[3703](#3703)        }
[3704](#3704)
[3705](#3705)        let wrapped = self.wrap_lines(inner.width);
[3706](#3706)        let total = wrapped.len() as u16;
[3707](#3707)        let start = self
[3708](#3708)            .scroll_offset
[3709](#3709)            .min(total.saturating_sub(inner.height.min(total)));
[3710](#3710)
[3711](#3711)        for row in 0..inner.height {
[3712](#3712)            let line_idx = start as usize + row as usize;
[3713](#3713)            let y = inner.y + row;
[3714](#3714)
[3715](#3715)            if line_idx >= wrapped.len() {
[3716](#3716)                break;
[3717](#3717)            }
[3718](#3718)
[3719](#3719)            let line = &wrapped[line_idx];
[3720](#3720)            let chars: Vec<char> = line.chars().collect();
[3721](#3721)
[3722](#3722)            for col in 0..inner.width {
[3723](#3723)                let ch = chars.get(col as usize).copied().unwrap_or(' ');
[3724](#3724)                let style = if ch == ' ' {
[3725](#3725)                    Style::default()
[3726](#3726)                } else {
[3727](#3727)                    Style::default().fg(self.palette.high)
[3728](#3728)                };
[3729](#3729)                set_styled_char(buf, inner.x + col, y, ch, style);
[3730](#3730)            }
[3731](#3731)        }
[3732](#3732)    }
[3733](#3733)}

[3827](#3827)impl Widget for StatusBar<'_> {
[3828](#3828)    fn render(&self, buf: &mut Buffer, area: Rect) {

[3830](#3830)            return;
[3831](#3831)        }
[3832](#3832)
[3833](#3833)        let bg_style = Style::default()
[3834](#3834)            .fg(self.palette.high)
[3835](#3835)            .bg(self.palette.shadow);
[3836](#3836)
[3837](#3837)        for x in area.x..area.x.saturating_add(area.width) {
[3838](#3838)            for y in area.y..area.y.saturating_add(area.height) {

[3840](#3840)            }
[3841](#3841)        }
[3842](#3842)
[3843](#3843)        let left_sections: Vec<_> = self
[3844](#3844)            .sections
[3845](#3845)            .iter()
[3846](#3846)            .filter(|s| s.align == Align::Left)
[3847](#3847)            .collect();
[3848](#3848)        let center_sections: Vec<_> = self
[3849](#3849)            .sections
[3850](#3850)            .iter()
[3851](#3851)            .filter(|s| s.align == Align::Center)
[3852](#3852)            .collect();
[3853](#3853)        let right_sections: Vec<_> = self
[3854](#3854)            .sections
[3855](#3855)            .iter()
[3856](#3856)            .filter(|s| s.align == Align::Right)
[3857](#3857)            .collect();
[3858](#3858)
[3859](#3859)        let mut x = area.x;
[3860](#3860)
[3861](#3861)        for section in &left_sections {
[3862](#3862)            let text: Vec<char> = section.text.chars().collect();
[3863](#3863)            let max_len = text
[3864](#3864)                .len()
[3865](#3865)                .min(usize::from(area.width.saturating_sub(x - area.x)));
[3866](#3866)            for (i, &ch) in text.iter().take(max_len).enumerate() {
[3867](#3867)                set_styled_char(
[3868](#3868)                    buf,
[3869](#3869)                    x + i as u16,
[3870](#3870)                    area.y,
[3871](#3871)                    ch,
[3872](#3872)                    Style::default()
[3873](#3873)                        .fg(self.palette.high)
[3874](#3874)                        .add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD),
[3875](#3875)                );
[3876](#3876)            }
[3877](#3877)            x += max_len as u16;
[3878](#3878)        }
[3879](#3879)
[3880](#3880)        for section in ¢er_sections {
[3881](#3881)            let text: Vec<char> = section.text.chars().collect();
[3882](#3882)            let available = area.width.saturating_sub(x - area.x);
[3883](#3883)            let start_offset = available.saturating_sub(text.len() as u16) / 2;
[3884](#3884)            x += start_offset;
[3885](#3885)            for (i, &ch) in text.iter().take(usize::from(available)).enumerate() {
[3886](#3886)                set_styled_char(
[3887](#3887)                    buf,
[3888](#3888)                    x + i as u16,
[3889](#3889)                    area.y,
[3890](#3890)                    ch,
[3891](#3891)                    Style::default()
[3892](#3892)                        .fg(self.palette.high)
[3893](#3893)                        .add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD),
[3894](#3894)                );
[3895](#3895)            }
[3896](#3896)            x += text.len() as u16;
[3897](#3897)        }
[3898](#3898)
[3899](#3899)        let right_x = area.x + area.width;
[3900](#3900)        let mut render_x = right_x;
[3901](#3901)        for section in right_sections.iter().rev() {
[3902](#3902)            let text: Vec<char> = section.text.chars().collect();
[3903](#3903)            render_x = render_x.saturating_sub(text.len() as u16);
[3904](#3904)            for (i, &ch) in text.iter().enumerate() {
[3905](#3905)                if render_x + (i as u16) >= area.x && render_x + (i as u16) < right_x {
[3906](#3906)                    set_styled_char(
[3907](#3907)                        buf,
[3908](#3908)                        render_x + i as u16,
[3909](#3909)                        area.y,
[3910](#3910)                        ch,
[3911](#3911)                        Style::default()
[3912](#3912)                            .fg(self.palette.high)
[3913](#3913)                            .add_modifier(Modifier::BOLD),
[3914](#3914)                    );
[3915](#3915)                }
[3916](#3916)            }
[3917](#3917)        }
[3918](#3918)    }
[3919](#3919)}
[3920](#3920)
[3921](#3921)#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
[3928](#3928)pub struct Bordered<'a> {
[3929](#3929)    title: Cow<'a, str>,
[3930](#3930)    palette: AislingPalette,
[3931](#3931)}
[3932](#3932)
[3933](#3933)impl PartialEq for Bordered<'_> {
[3934](#3934)    fn eq(&self, other: &Self) -> bool {
[3935](#3935)        self.title == other.title && self.palette == other.palette
[3936](#3936)    }
[3937](#3937)}
[3938](#3938)
[3939](#3939)impl<'a> Bordered<'a> {
[3940](#3940)    #[must_use]
[3942](#3942)    pub fn new(title: impl Into<Cow<'a, str>>) -> Self {
[3943](#3943)        Self {
[3944](#3944)            title: title.into(),
[3945](#3945)            palette: AislingPalette::cypherpunk(),
[3946](#3946)        }
[3947](#3947)    }
[3948](#3948)
[3949](#3949)    #[must_use]
[3951](#3951)    pub fn palette(mut self, palette: AislingPalette) -> Self {
[3952](#3952)        self.palette = palette;
[3953](#3953)        self
[3954](#3954)    }
[3955](#3955)
[3956](#3956)    pub fn render_inner(&self, buf: &mut Buffer, area: Rect) -> Rect {
[3958](#3958)        let block = Block::new(self.title.as_ref())
[3959](#3959)            .with_borders(BorderStyle::Plain)
[3960](#3960)            .with_border_color(self.palette.mid);
[3961](#3961)        let inner = block_content_area(&block, area);
[3962](#3962)        block.render(buf, area);
[3963](#3963)        inner
[3964](#3964)    }
[3965](#3965)}
[3966](#3966)
[3967](#3967)impl Widget for Bordered<'_> {
[3968](#3968)    fn render(&self, buf: &mut Buffer, area: Rect) {
[3969](#3969)        self.render_inner(buf, area);
[3970](#3970)    }
[3971](#3971)}
[3972](#3972)
[3973](#3973)fn is_empty(area: Rect) -> bool {
[3978](#3978)    area.width == 0 || area.height == 0
[3979](#3979)}
[3980](#3980)
[3981](#3981)fn block_content_area(block: &Block<'_>, area: Rect) -> Rect {
[3982](#3982)    match block.borders {
[3983](#3983)        BorderStyle::None => area,
[3984](#3984)        _ => Rect::new(
[3985](#3985)            area.x.saturating_add(1),
[3986](#3986)            area.y.saturating_add(1),
[3987](#3987)            area.width.saturating_sub(2),
[3988](#3988)            area.height.saturating_sub(2),
[3989](#3989)        ),
[3990](#3990)    }
[3991](#3991)}
[3992](#3992)
[3993](#3993)fn option_block_eq(left: Option<&Block<'_>>, right: Option<&Block<'_>>) -> bool {
[3994](#3994)    match (left, right) {
[3995](#3995)        (Some(left), Some(right)) => block_eq(left, right),
[3996](#3996)        (None, None) => true,
[3997](#3997)        _ => false,
[3998](#3998)    }
[3999](#3999)}
[4000](#4000)
[4001](#4001)fn block_eq(left: &Block<'_>, right: &Block<'_>) -> bool {
[4002](#4002)    left.title == right.title
[4003](#4003)        && left.title_right == right.title_right
[4004](#4004)        && left.borders == right.borders
[4005](#4005)        && left.border_color == right.border_color
[4006](#4006)        && left.bg == right.bg
[4007](#4007)        && left.style == right.style
[4008](#4008)        && left.inner_margin == right.inner_margin
[4009](#4009)}
[4010](#4010)
[4011](#4011)fn is_edge(area: Rect, x: u16, y: u16) -> bool {
[4012](#4012)    x == area.x
[4013](#4013)        || y == area.y
[4014](#4014)        || x + 1 == area.x.saturating_add(area.width)
[4015](#4015)        || y + 1 == area.y.saturating_add(area.height)
[4016](#4016)}
[4017](#4017)
[4018](#4018)fn field_noise(x: u16, y: u16, tick: u64) -> u64 {
[4019](#4019)    let mut value = u64::from(x).wrapping_mul(0x9e37_79b9_7f4a_7c15)
[4020](#4020)        ^ u64::from(y).wrapping_mul(0xbf58_476d_1ce4_e5b9)
[4021](#4021)        ^ tick.wrapping_mul(0x94d0_49bb_1331_11eb);
[4022](#4022)    value ^= value >> 30;
[4023](#4023)    value = value.wrapping_mul(0xbf58_476d_1ce4_e5b9);
[4024](#4024)    value ^= value >> 27;
[4025](#4025)    value = value.wrapping_mul(0x94d0_49bb_1331_11eb);
[4026](#4026)    value ^ (value >> 31)
[4027](#4027)}
[4028](#4028)
[4029](#4029)fn paint_text(area: Rect, buf: &mut Buffer, text: &str, style: Style) {
[4030](#4030)    if is_empty(area) {
[4031](#4031)        return;
[4032](#4032)    }
[4033](#4033)
[4034](#4034)    let right = area.x.saturating_add(area.width);
[4035](#4035)    for (offset, glyph) in text.chars().take(usize::from(area.width)).enumerate() {
[4036](#4036)        let x = area.x + offset as u16;
[4037](#4037)        if x >= right {
[4038](#4038)            break;
[4039](#4039)        }
[4040](#4040)        set_styled_char(buf, x, area.y, glyph, style);
[4041](#4041)    }
[4042](#4042)}
[4043](#4043)
[4044](#4044)fn clipped_text(text: &str, width: u16) -> String {
[4045](#4045)    text.chars().take(usize::from(width)).collect()
[4046](#4046)}
[4047](#4047)
[4048](#4048)fn set_cell_bg(buf: &mut Buffer, x: u16, y: u16, bg: Color) {
[4049](#4049)    let Some(mut cell) = buf.get(usize::from(x), usize::from(y)).copied() else {
[4050](#4050)        return;
[4051](#4051)    };
[4052](#4052)    cell.bg = Some(bg);
[4053](#4053)    buf.set(usize::from(x), usize::from(y), cell);
[4054](#4054)}
[4055](#4055)
[4056](#4056)fn set_cell_style(buf: &mut Buffer, x: u16, y: u16, style: Style) {
[4057](#4057)    let Some(cell) = buf.get(usize::from(x), usize::from(y)).copied() else {
[4058](#4058)        return;
[4059](#4059)    };
[4060](#4060)    buf.set(usize::from(x), usize::from(y), replace_style(cell, style));
[4061](#4061)}
[4062](#4062)
[4063](#4063)fn set_styled_char(buf: &mut Buffer, x: u16, y: u16, ch: char, style: Style) {
[4064](#4064)    buf.set(
[4065](#4065)        usize::from(x),
[4066](#4066)        usize::from(y),
[4067](#4067)        replace_style(
[4068](#4068)            Cell::new(ch, style.fg.unwrap_or(Color::WHITE), style.bg),
[4069](#4069)            style,
[4070](#4070)        ),
[4071](#4071)    );
[4072](#4072)}
[4073](#4073)
[4074](#4074)fn replace_style(mut cell: Cell, style: Style) -> Cell {
[4075](#4075)    cell.fg = style.fg.unwrap_or(Color::WHITE);
[4076](#4076)    cell.bg = style.bg;
[4077](#4077)    cell.bold = (style.bold || style.add_modifier.contains(Modifier::BOLD))
[4078](#4078)        && !style.sub_modifier.contains(Modifier::BOLD);
[4079](#4079)    cell.italic = (style.italic || style.add_modifier.contains(Modifier::ITALIC))
[4080](#4080)        && !style.sub_modifier.contains(Modifier::ITALIC);
[4081](#4081)    cell.underlined = (style.underlined || style.add_modifier.contains(Modifier::UNDERLINED))
[4082](#4082)        && !style.sub_modifier.contains(Modifier::UNDERLINED);
[4083](#4083)    cell
[4084](#4084)}

# scrin - Rust

Source: https://docs.rs/scrin/0.1.83/x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu/scrin/index.html

## Expand description

Scrin is a Rust terminal UI toolkit for building polished command-line interfaces without depending on Ratatui.

It provides a Scrin-native rendering model with buffers, colors, rectangles,
layout constraints, styled text, widgets, interaction metadata, panes,
overlays, command palettes, status bars, input routing, terminal lifecycle
helpers, and animation glue.
The effects layer is powered by [ aisling](https://crates.io/crates/aisling)
and adapts Aisling frames into Scrin buffers, so loaders and text effects can
be composed with normal Scrin widgets.

[§](https://docs.rs#install)Install

```
[dependencies]
scrin = "0.1.83"
```
[§](https://docs.rs#draw-a-widget)Draw A Widget

```
use scrin::core::buffer::Buffer;
use scrin::core::color::Color;
use scrin::core::rect::Rect;
use scrin::style::Style;
use scrin::widgets::block::Block;
use scrin::widgets::Widget;
let mut buffer = Buffer::new(40, 8);
buffer.fill(Rect::new(0, 0, 40, 8), ' ', Color::WHITE, None);
let block = Block::bordered()
    .title("scrin")
    .border_style(Style::new().fg(Color::CYAN));
block.render(&mut buffer, Rect::new(0, 0, 40, 8));
```
[§](https://docs.rs#render-an-aisling-effect-into-a-scrin-buffer)Render An Aisling Effect Into A Scrin Buffer

```
use scrin::core::{buffer::Buffer, rect::Rect};
use scrin::effects::{EffectKind, EffectPlayer};
let mut buffer = Buffer::new(60, 6);
let mut effect = EffectPlayer::new(EffectKind::Matrix, "Scrin + Aisling")
    .with_size(60, 6)
    .with_duration(24);
effect.render_to_buffer(&mut buffer, Rect::new(0, 0, 60, 6));
effect.advance();
```
[§](https://docs.rs#render-an-aisling-loader)Render An Aisling Loader

```
use scrin::core::{buffer::Buffer, rect::Rect};
use scrin::effects::{LoaderKind, LoaderPlayer};
let mut buffer = Buffer::new(48, 4);
let loader = LoaderPlayer::new(LoaderKind::Bar)
    .with_size(48, 4)
    .with_label("indexing".to_string());
let progress = LoaderPlayer::progress_from_fraction(0.42);
loader.render(3, progress, &mut buffer, Rect::new(0, 0, 48, 4));
```
[§](https://docs.rs#terminal-rendering)Terminal Rendering

[ Terminal::draw](https://docs.rs/terminal/struct.Terminal.html#method.draw) uses Scrin’s diff presenter and updates only changed
cells.

[is available when an application wants a full buffer repaint every frame, for example during dense animation.](https://docs.rs/terminal/struct.Terminal.html#method.draw_full)

`Terminal::draw_full`[§](https://docs.rs#re-exports)Re-Exports

Common Aisling selector/config types are re-exported from [ effects](https://docs.rs/effects/index.html) so a
Scrin application can choose effects and loaders through one crate path.

[§](https://docs.rs#performance-apis)Performance APIs

Larger Scrin applications can use [ widgets::ScrollableText](https://docs.rs/widgets/scroll_text/struct.ScrollableText.html) for retained
styled-text wrapping,

[for cached Markdown rows, retained Aisling widgets through](https://docs.rs/widgets/markdown_output/struct.RetainedMarkdownOutput.html)

`widgets::RetainedMarkdownOutput`[and](https://docs.rs/effects/retained/struct.RetainedEffectWidget.html)

`effects::RetainedEffectWidget`[, dirty-rectangle presentation through](https://docs.rs/effects/retained/struct.RetainedLoaderWidget.html)

`effects::RetainedLoaderWidget`[, strategy-based drawing through](https://docs.rs/terminal/struct.Terminal.html#method.present_areas)

`Terminal::present_areas`[, cursor-preserving area draws through](https://docs.rs/terminal/struct.Terminal.html#method.draw_with_present_strategy)

`Terminal::draw_with_present_strategy`[, frame diagnostics through](https://docs.rs/terminal/struct.Terminal.html#method.draw_area_preserve_cursor_timed)

`Terminal::draw_area_preserve_cursor_timed`[/](https://docs.rs/terminal/struct.FrameTiming.html)

`FrameTiming`[/](https://docs.rs/terminal/struct.FrameDiagnostic.html)

`FrameDiagnostic`[, and shared widget roles through](https://docs.rs/terminal/struct.NamedFrameTiming.html)

`NamedFrameTiming`[. Retained Aisling hot paths can use](https://docs.rs/theme/struct.ThemeTokens.html)

`ThemeTokens`[and](https://docs.rs/effects/retained/struct.RetainedEffectWidget.html#method.render_frame_into)

`effects::RetainedEffectWidget::render_frame_into`[to avoid mutating widget state or doing unexpected cache rebuild work.](https://docs.rs/effects/retained/struct.RetainedEffectWidget.html#method.render_cached_only)

`effects::RetainedEffectWidget::render_cached_only`[§](https://docs.rs#interaction-apis)Interaction APIs

[ interaction](https://docs.rs/interaction/index.html) contains stable

[values,](https://docs.rs/interaction/struct.WidgetId.html)

`WidgetId`[metadata,](https://docs.rs/interaction/struct.HitRegion.html)

`HitRegion`[roles, selectable spans, hover tracking, selection models, and normalized](https://docs.rs/interaction/enum.WidgetRole.html)

`WidgetRole`[output for mouse move/down/drag/up/click events. Frames can register metadata with](https://docs.rs/interaction/enum.UiEvent.html)

`UiEvent`[,](https://docs.rs/terminal/struct.Frame.html#method.register_hit_region)

`Frame::register_hit_region`[, and](https://docs.rs/terminal/struct.Frame.html#method.register_selectable_span)

`Frame::register_selectable_span`[. Terminals can query the latest frame with](https://docs.rs/terminal/struct.Frame.html#method.mark_dirty)

`Frame::mark_dirty`[,](https://docs.rs/terminal/struct.Terminal.html#method.hit_test)

`Terminal::hit_test`[,](https://docs.rs/terminal/struct.Terminal.html#method.scroll_hit_test)

`Terminal::scroll_hit_test`[, and](https://docs.rs/terminal/struct.Terminal.html#method.selectable_at)

`Terminal::selectable_at`[.](https://docs.rs/terminal/struct.Terminal.html#method.handle_pointer_event)

`Terminal::handle_pointer_event`Metadata-aware widget surfaces include [ widgets::CodeBlock](https://docs.rs/widgets/code/struct.CodeBlock.html),

[,](https://docs.rs/widgets/markdown_output/struct.RetainedMarkdownOutput.html)

`widgets::RetainedMarkdownOutput`[,](https://docs.rs/widgets/scroll_text/struct.ScrollableText.html)

`widgets::ScrollableText`[,](https://docs.rs/widgets/list/struct.List.html)

`widgets::List`[,](https://docs.rs/widgets/tabs/struct.Tabs.html)

`widgets::Tabs`[,](https://docs.rs/widgets/transcript_viewport/struct.TranscriptViewport.html)

`widgets::TranscriptViewport`[,](https://docs.rs/widgets/status_deck/struct.StatusDeck.html)

`widgets::StatusDeck`[,](https://docs.rs/widgets/todo_list/struct.TodoList.html)

`widgets::TodoList`[,](https://docs.rs/widgets/pane_cockpit/struct.PaneCockpit.html)

`widgets::PaneCockpit`[, and](https://docs.rs/widgets/kanban_board/struct.KanbanBoard.html)

`widgets::KanbanBoard`[.](https://docs.rs/effects/retained/struct.CachedEffectPane.html)

`effects::CachedEffectPane`[§](https://docs.rs#application-validation)Application Validation

Full-screen applications should pair Scrin’s crate-level tests with app-level pseudo-terminal captures for frame output, prompt input, overlays, provider setup, and terminal restore paths. A real-terminal visual pass is still useful for subjective clipping, spacing, contrast, and animation pacing.

# scrin_widgets::prelude - Rust

Source: https://docs.rs/scrin-widgets/0.2.7/scrin_widgets/prelude/index.html

## Expand description

## Expand description

Wraps any Scrin widget with an Aisling post-render effect.

Tests for `self` and `other` values to be equal, and is used by `==`.

Tests for `!=`. The default implementation is almost always sufficient,
and should not be overridden without very good reason.

Decorates this widget with the default Aisling effect.
